description_en: Invoke this API to batch import external data into the IoT Platform. Data imported into the IoT Platform through this API is referred to as data from an API data source. You can batch upload data from your local environment or other platforms to the IoT Platform for data analysis and processing
description_zh: 调用该接口向物联网平台批量导入外部数据。通过此API导入物联网平台的数据，称为API数据源的数据。您可将本地或其他平台的数据批量上传至物联网平台，用于数据的分析和处理
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-add-data-for-api-source --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n00000 --api-id cxatswiniekxw000 --content-list key_:_value1_,_ts_:1637658286000_,_key_:_value2_,_ts_:1637658287000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchAddDataForApiSource

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The data content to be batch uploaded to the IoT Platform, in JSON list format.
- The JSON list must contain no more than 100 JSON objects.
- Each JSON object must include the **ts** field, which indicates the timestamp (in milliseconds, UNIX timestamp format) when the data was generated.
parameters.description_zh:
批量上传到物联网平台的数据内容，为JSON列表格式。
- JSON列表中JSON对象个数不得超过100个。
- JSON中必须包含**ts**字段，用来表示数据产生的时间点（unix 毫秒精度的时间戳）。
